record.paper_title: Some Recent Results and Open Problems on Sets of Lengths of Krull Monoids with Finite Class Group
record.original_question: Let G be a finite abelian group. For each subset G0 of G whose zero-sum-sequence monoid has a nonempty distance set Delta(G0), form the minimum distance min Delta(G0), and let Delta*(G) be the set of all such minima. Does there exist a finite abelian group G for which Delta*(G) is an interval and exp(G) >= 2r(G) + 2, where r(G) is the rank of G and exp(G) is the exponent of G in its invariant-factor decomposition?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, written in invariant-factor form $G \cong \mathbb{Z}/n_1\mathbb{Z} \oplus \cdots \oplus \mathbb{Z}/n_r\mathbb{Z}$ with $1 < n_1 \mid n_2 \mid \cdots \mid n_r$; set $r(G) = r$ (the rank) and $\exp(G) = n_r$ (the exponent). For a subset $G_0 \subseteq G$, let $\mathcal{B}(G_0)$ denote the monoid of zero-sum sequences over $G_0$ (the finitely generated submonoid of the free abelian monoid $\mathcal{F}(G_0)$ consisting of all sequences $S = g_1 \cdots g_\ell$ with $g_1 + \cdots + g_\ell = 0$ in $G$). For a zero-sum sequence $S \in \mathcal{B}(G_0)$, let $\mathsf{L}(S) \subseteq \mathbb{N}$ be its set of lengths, i.e., the set of all $k$ such that $S$ can be written as a product of $k$ atoms (irreducible elements) of $\mathcal{B}(G_0)$. Define
$$\Delta(G_0) = \bigcup_{S \in \mathcal{B}(G_0),\, |\mathsf{L}(S)| \ge 2} \{\, \ell_{i+1} - \ell_i : \mathsf{L}(S) = \{\ell_1 < \ell_2 < \cdots\}\,\},$$
the distance set of $G_0$. Define
$$\Delta^{*}(G) = \{\, \min \Delta(G_0) : G_0 \subseteq G \text{ with } \Delta(G_0) \ne \emptyset \,\}.$$
A subset of $\mathbb{N}$ is called an interval if it equals $\{a, a+1, \dots, b\}$ for some $a \le b$.

Question: Does there exist a finite abelian group $G$ such that $\Delta^{*}(G)$ is an interval and $\exp(G) \ge 2\, r(G) + 2$?

artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not produce a paper resolving the question of whether some finite abelian group $G$ has $\Delta^{*}(G)$ equal to an interval while satisfying $\exp(G) \ge 2 r(G) + 2$. Related work on $\Delta^{*}(G)$ for Krull monoids with finite class group exists, but no clear resolution of this specific problem was found.

status_evidence.title: Zero-sum problems in finite abelian groups: A survey
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of zero-sum problems in finite abelian groups; does not resolve the specific interval property for Delta*(G).
status_evidence.claim: The general area is actively studied but no direct resolution of the stated problem appears in the surveyed literature.
